module_summary: Splits one wide memory request into per-bank requests through fall-through request FIFOs, and recombines per-bank responses via response FIFOs, granting only when all bank FIFOs can accept.

anchors.name: req_i
anchors.why: Wide memory request valid; with gnt_o pushes all bank FIFOs.

anchors.name: gnt_o
anchors.why: Grant when all request and response FIFOs have space.

anchors.name: wdata_i
anchors.why: Wide write data sliced into per-bank write data.

anchors.name: rdata_o
anchors.why: Wide read data reassembled from bank response FIFOs.

anchors.name: addr_i
anchors.why: Byte address aligned and offset per bank.

anchors.name: we_i
anchors.why: Write enable carried into every bank request.

anchors.name: rvalid_o
anchors.why: Response valid when all bank responses (or dead responses) present.

anchors.name: bank_req_o
anchors.why: Per-bank request valid from request FIFO output.

anchors.name: bank_gnt_i
anchors.why: Per-bank grant popping the request FIFO.

anchors.name: bank_addr_o
anchors.why: Per-bank address from request FIFO.

anchors.name: bank_wdata_o
anchors.why: Per-bank write data slice from request FIFO.

anchors.name: bank_rdata_i
anchors.why: Per-bank read data pushed into response FIFO.

anchors.name: bank_rvalid_i
anchors.why: Per-bank response valid pushing response FIFO.

anchors.name: bank_req
anchors.why: Per-bank request struct built from address, data slice and strobe.

anchors.name: bank_oup
anchors.why: Per-bank request struct at request FIFO output.

anchors.name: req_valid
anchors.why: Accepted request pushes all bank request FIFOs.

anchors.name: req_ready
anchors.why: Per-bank request FIFO ready combined into gnt_o.

anchors.name: resp_ready
anchors.why: Per-bank response FIFO ready combined into gnt_o.

anchors.name: resp_valid
anchors.why: Per-bank response available, ANDed into rvalid_o.

anchors.name: dead_response
anchors.why: Marks hidden zero-strobe writes completed internally; disabled unless HideStrb.

anchors.name: dead_write_fifo_full
anchors.why: Dead write FIFO full blocks gnt_o; tied off unless HideStrb.

groups.name: Request split FIFOs
groups.description: Per-bank fall-through FIFOs holding sliced address, data, strobe and we.

groups.name: Response merge FIFOs
groups.description: Per-bank response FIFOs reassembled into one wide response.

groups.name: Grant and dead-write control
groups.description: Grants request when all FIFOs ready; tracks hidden zero-strobe writes.
